scheduler_lock_contract.purpose: Serialize scheduler-mediated production audits and hold the lock through asynchronous workflow verification; the live fencing proof is checked at audit start and immediately before publishing to main.
scheduler_lock_contract.coverage_boundary: Scheduler-mediated production workflow and independently scheduled source assessor share logical/production-pipeline. Assessor also fences each logical output and every JSON document-store mutation. Other future independent Python writers must declare compatible contracts before enablement.
